item.text: {"summary":"The draft is publication-ready on resolver, units, first-print policy, prior/update structure, interval coherence, and leakage checks, with only minor clarity improvements suggested.","requiredFixes":[],"optionalSuggestions":["Clarify that the cited FNS page currently shows national monthly data only through November 2025, so no later FY 2026 observations were used.","The seasonal-lift claim would be stronger if phrased as a small judgmental adjustment rather than saying May normally sits above winter participation, since the displayed reference class is short.","Consider stating that the 80% interval is the 10th to 90th percentile from the threshold ladder."]}
